newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi firm plans to build $40 mln textile plant.
newsitem.headline: Saudi firm plans to build $40 mln textile plant.

text.p: The Al-Ahsa Development Company of Saudi Arabia said on Sunday it planned to build a 150 million riyal ($40 million) textile plant in the kingdom.
A company official said the Saudi Industrial Development Fund had agreed to extend a 75 million riyal loan to partly finance the project.
He said the project would be built in the industrial city of Al-Ahsa in Saudi Arabia's eastern province.
Al-Ahsa Development Company's General Manager Sadoun Saad al-Sadoun told Reuters the plant would have the capacity to produce 11 million yards of textiles per year.
He said Japan's Marubeni Corporation would provide the technical services and know-how through a Japanese company specialised in textile production. He gave no details. ($=3.75 riyals)
